name: PiPT
summary: A rare psychedelic tryptamine related to DPT. There is little known about the effects or safety profile of this compound.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It reportedly produces hallucinogenic effects that resemble those of other related dialkyl tryptamine derivatives, although PiPT is reportedly relatively weak and short-lasting.

uses.text: It has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in 2021 in British Columbia, Canada.

summaryZh: N-丙基-N-異丙基色胺是一種有機化合物，分子式C16H24N2，屬於一種N,N-二烴基色胺衍生物，可作為致幻劑與迷幻藥物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Tryptamine psychedelics as a group can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。色胺類迷幻藥整體而言可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快和驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。色胺类迷幻药整体而言可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快和惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: PiPT sits between DPT and DiPT in structure: its nitrogen carries one straight propyl group and one branched isopropyl group.
fact.zh: PiPT 的結構介於 DPT 和 DiPT 之間：它的氮原子上連著一個直鏈的丙基和一個分支的異丙基。
fact.zhHans: PiPT 的结构介于 DPT 和 DiPT 之间：它的氮原子上连着一个直链的丙基和一个分支的异丙基。
